candidate.scope: Move floating-point/step suitability checks to once per build row. Reciprocal multiplication only when step and reciprocal are normal and both lie in [2^-1022, 2^1022]; otherwise retain division.
candidate.implementation_state: implementation and tests in progress; no Linux performance result recorded
candidate.build_identity: The eventual actual original-root Docker image and extracted ELF must be bound to the committed candidate source; preparation is not a completed build.

ee.identity: Previously verified original-source, original-Docker rebuild; not the recovered official evaluation binary.

retained.identity: Previously verified retained actual program, imported without rebuilding.

build_plan.compiler_flags_training: Existing original-root compiler, four macros and training corpus unchanged.

ratio_definition: For every reported pair r = candidate / reference; values above one are worse. Use paired ratios, never ratio of pooled means.

metric_definitions.first_lifecycle_wall_seconds: Sum startup + create_table + ingest + index_build + first 1000 query phase + first shutdown. Stage timer sum, not continuously measured end-to-end time; excludes restart.
metric_definitions.first_1000_queries_wall_seconds: Complete first query phase wall time, not first request alone.
metric_definitions.first_1000_queries_cpu_usec: Observed cgroup CPU delta for the first query phase. Not first-request CPU.
metric_definitions.first_query_wall_seconds: First request wall time in the initial query phase.
metric_definitions.ingest_wall_seconds: Observed ingest phase including BEGIN, INSERT requests and COMMIT.
metric_definitions.ingest_cpu_usec: Observed cgroup CPU delta spanning the ingest phase.
metric_definitions.complete_lifecycle_cpu_usec: Actual full database cgroup CPU delta, including restart and verification work.
metric_definitions.max_process_rss_bytes: Maximum RSS among the recorded per-phase process samples; not the true process high-water mark.
metric_definitions.first_query_cpu: Not measured. Do not add sampling, estimate it, or relabel query-phase CPU as first-request CPU.

screen_rules.necessary_gates: All correctness, oracle, identity, declared mode, CPU/memory/swap, durability and timeout checks must pass. Every one of the fixed 24 pairs is required.

EE_each_CPU_required.scope: Both 1 CPU and 2 CPU arms must satisfy all conditions separately. This is an engineering screen threshold, not a statistical-significance claim.

R_default_each_CPU.stable_regression_rule: For the same metric, overall median, AB-only median and BA-only median must all be strictly above its threshold to trigger a block. A trigger in either CPU arm blocks default adoption.

spill_not_measured: Pure ingest CPU is unavailable because there is no before_ingest sample; cgroup start to after_ingest includes startup/create and must not be relabelled as ingest CPU.
wide_guarded_metrics: sum of all seven query phases wall
sum of the seven observed query phase CPU deltas
wide_not_measured: No process RSS samples; do not invent RSS/HWM or substitute cgroup memory.
No pure ingest CPU or separate first-request CPU gate.
R_protection.stable_regression_rule: For the same measured metric, both the AB and BA pair must individually be strictly above its threshold. No average across distinct projection/query phases.
R_protection.wide_aggregation: Sum the seven measured phase wall values and, separately, their seven CPU deltas within each run before calculating a candidate/reference ratio. This is a single aggregate query guard, not seven separate phase gates or an average of phase ratios.
R_protection.not_guarded_individually: Startup/create/index/tiny setup phases, individual wide query phases and partial query windows are still fully reported, but are not separately counted as multiple adoption gates.

screen_rules.first_query_CPU_policy: Not measured; no invented or estimated first-query CPU gate.
screen_rules.undefined_or_missing: Missing required measurements, zero denominators, nonfinite ratios or identity gaps make the screen inconclusive; no missing sample is silently dropped. A scenario never recording a metric is explicitly not measured, not passed.
decision_order: any R regression block -> keep R
either EE primary arm fails -> keep R
all conditions pass -> eligible for one independent confirmation only; keep R until confirmed
anti_selection: Freeze the workload, order and decision thresholds before execution.
Retain every positive and negative pair and all phase/resource observations.
Do not pool CPU arms, references or hosts; do not multiply cross-arm ratios.
An isolated index-build win cannot replace the first-cycle/query criteria.
No third/favorable-result hunt or hardware selection; failures do not authorize replacement samples.
Any necessary harness correction preserves invalid original evidence and requires an explicit separately recorded revision before a new complete experiment.
The screen does not establish a formal score, a score floor, or authorization to submit. Formal submission remains the user's decision.
